claimPolicy: A maturity stage may be claimed only when every required condition for that stage is evidenced; target roles do not count as staffed roles.

stages.description: Founder-led personal repository with scalable structures prepared but not yet independently staffed.
Multiple independent reviewers/maintainers can safely absorb external contributions.
Critical authority is no longer operationally dependent on one person and the serial integration lease can rotate.
The project can continue normal governance and releases through founder or individual maintainer absence.
